task: What are the Nearby Attractions from the most popular attraction in Hong Kong?
agent_final_answer:
The most popular attraction in Hong Kong on Trip.com (Attractions tab sorted by "Popularity") is Hong Kong Disneyland.

On its detail page, the "Nearby" section titled "Attractions near Hong Kong Disneyland" lists the following Nearby Attractions:

1. The Peak Tram - 4.6/5 (11,145 reviews)
2. Ocean Park Hong Kong - 4.6/5 (48,098 reviews)
3. Victoria Peak - 4.6/5 (19,112 reviews)
4. Hong Kong Palace Museum - 4.7/5 (5,758 reviews)
5. Hong Kong Observation Wheel - 4.6/5 (3,994 reviews)
6. Victoria Harbour - 4.7/5 (7,219 reviews)
7. Ngong Ping 360 - 4.7/5 (12,716 reviews)
8. Big Bus Tours Hong Kong - 4.4/5 (612 reviews)
9. M+ - 4.7/5 (1,823 reviews)
10. Central - 4.6/5 (5,843 reviews)
11. Madame Tussauds Hong Kong - 4.6/5 (4,699 reviews)
12. The Star Ferry - 4.5/5 (2,600 reviews)
13. Lan Kwai Fong - 4.6/5 (3,058 reviews)
14. LEGOLAND Discovery Centre Hong Kong - 4.2/5 (850 reviews)
15. Hong Kong Macau Ferry Terminal - 4.6/5 (757 reviews)
16. Tsim Sha Tsui - 4.7/5 (7,742 reviews)

The list also mixes in a few concert/event listings (e.g. Hong Kong Football Festival 2026, 2026 Lee Youngji World Tour, Post Malone concert).
